mapper.sql: r.id, r.user_id, r.name, r.description, r.completion_criteria, r.start_date, r.expected_end_date, r.status, r.archived_at, r.completion_condition_met, r.completion_round, r.version, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goal (user_id, name, description, completion_criteria, start_date, expected_end_date, status, archived_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{completionCriteria}, #{startDate}, #{expectedEndDate}, #{status}, #{archivedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE goal SET name=#{name}, description=#{description}, completion_criteria=#{completionCriteria}, start_date=#{startDate}, expected_end_date=#{expectedEndDate}, status=#{status}, archived_at=#{archivedAt}, completion_condition_met=#{completionConditionMet}, version=version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND version=#{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(t.weight::numeric) FILTER (WHERE t.status='COMPLETED'),0)/NULLIF(SUM(t.weight::numeric),0),2) FROM goal g LEFT JOIN stage s ON s.goal_id=g.id AND s.user_id=g.user_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN task t ON t.stage_id=s.id AND t.user_id=g.user_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE g.user_id=#{userId} AND g.id=#{id} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL
